source: ENISA Space Threat Landscape 2025, Annex C Table 17 (via Phalanx/framework/enisa_threats_tuple.csv)
name: Security services failure
affected_asset_selectors: Ground: Satellite control / TT&C system (security safeguards: firewalls, virus scans, log monitoring unavailable)
description: Unavailability of security safeguards such as firewalls, virus scans, log monitoring, etc. due to either system failure or malicious action of an adversary. Security services are key for ensuring confidentiality, integrity and availability of satellite lifecycle processes, their disruption may hence compromise each satellite lifecycle asset.
